calls.title: GrowthBook Demo for Alasans
calls.summary: The discussion centered on the team's dissatisfaction with their current A/B testing tool, Convert, due to an 80% data loss impacting GA4 reports, which undermines decision-making. Jakub emphasized the urgent need for a more reliable tool that integrates with their BigQuery database, especially as they conduct around 27 experiments monthly across nearly 30 e-shops in Europe. These tests typically yield a 3% to 5% conversion uplift, crucial for their revenue generation. Plans were laid out to start with the Growth Book Pro version to evaluate its capabilities, allowing for five experiments per month at a subscription cost of US$40 per user, before considering an upgrade to the Enterprise version. Immediate testing is prioritized with the cloud-hosted Pro version, while an edge deployment via Cloudflare is anticipated for the future.
calls.keywords: A/B testing, Growth Book, Convert, experimentation, pricing, e-commerce
